body.purpose: Reading copy, form labels, and controls.

motion.name: report-arrival
motion.purpose: Brings the completed analysis report into view.

components.name: Primary Analysis Button
components.description: The one dominant action that submits the email for classification.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 19px; border: 1px solid var(--pine); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--pine); color: #fffdf5; font: 600 14px "IBM Plex Sans", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary-action:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: #24584d; background: #24584d; } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--rust); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary-action:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: 0.72; }

components.name: Text Action
components.description: An unboxed underlined action for loading the sample or resetting the form.
components.css: .ds-text-action { padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--pine); font: 600 13px "IBM Plex Sans", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #95a49b; text-underline-offset: 0.25em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-text-action:hover:not(:disabled) { color: var(--rust); text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-text-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--rust); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-text-action:disabled { color: var(--muted); cursor: wait; }

components.name: Subject Field
components.description: A single-line subject field on the lighter proof-sheet surface.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-subject">Subjek</label><input class="ds-subject" id="ds-subject" type="text" placeholder="Subjek email">
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; color: var(--ink); font: 600 13px/1.55 "IBM Plex Sans", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-subject { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 13px; border: 1px solid #c7c4b9; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--sheet); color: var(--ink); caret-color: var(--rust); font: 400 16px/1.55 "IBM Plex Sans", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-subject::placeholder { color: #596763; opacity: 1; } .ds-subject:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--rust); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-subject:disabled { background: #eae7dd; color: var(--muted); cursor: wait; }

components.name: Email Body Field
components.description: The vertically resizable message field, sized for long-form email text.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-body">Isi email</label><textarea class="ds-body" id="ds-body" rows="12" placeholder="Tempel isi email di sini…"></textarea>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; color: var(--ink); font: 600 13px/1.55 "IBM Plex Sans", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-body { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 286px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #c7c4b9; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--sheet); color: var(--ink); caret-color: var(--rust); font: 400 16px/1.65 "IBM Plex Sans", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; resize: vertical; } .ds-body::placeholder { color: #596763; opacity: 1; } .ds-body:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--rust); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-body:disabled { background: #eae7dd; color: var(--muted); cursor: wait; }

components.name: Masthead
components.description: The pine shell holds the Saring wordmark and current model availability.
components.html:
Saring.

Berkas model tersedia

components.css: .ds-masthead { min-height: 82px; padding: 0 clamp(22px, 6vw, 88px); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 28px; background: var(--pine); color: #f8f5ea; font: 400 12px/1.55 "IBM Plex Sans", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-wordmark { color: inherit; font: 600 30px/1 "Literata", Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -0.035em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-wordmark span { color: #d16b4b; } .ds-model-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; margin: 0; color: #e3e9dc; } .ds-model-status i { width: 7px; height: 7px; flex: none; border-radius: 50%; background: #b6d5ad; } .ds-divider { width: 1px; height: 18px; background: rgb(248 245 234 / 34%); } .ds-model-name { margin: 0; color: #e3e9dc; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-masthead { min-height: 72px; } .ds-model-name, .ds-divider { display: none; } }

components.css: .ds-url-gutter { position: relative; padding: 20px 0 22px 18px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--ink); font: 400 12px/1.55 "IBM Plex Sans", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-url-gutter::before { position: absolute; top: 20px; bottom: 22px; left: 2px; width: 1px; background: var(--measure); content: ""; } .ds-url-heading { margin-bottom: 11px; } .ds-url-heading p { margin: 0 0 2px; color: var(--leaf); font: 400 10px/1.55 "IBM Plex Mono", Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.09em; } .ds-url-heading h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-url-gutter dl { margin: 0; } .ds-url-gutter dl div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 14px; align-items: baseline; padding: 7px 0; border-top: 1px solid #dedbd2; } .ds-url-gutter dt { color: var(--muted); } .ds-url-gutter dd { margin: 0; color: var(--ink); font: 400 11px/1.55 "IBM Plex Mono", Consolas, monospace; text-align: right; }

components.name: Probability Measurement
components.description: A narrow amber bar reports the model probability independently from URL observations.
components.css: .ds-probability { padding: 17px 0 22px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--ink); font: 400 14px/1.55 "IBM Plex Sans", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-probability > div:first-child { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; } .ds-probability h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-probability strong { color: var(--pine); font: 500 13px/1.55 "IBM Plex Mono", Consolas, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-probability-track { height: 5px; margin-top: 10px; overflow: hidden; background: #dcd9cf; } .ds-probability-track span { display: block; width: 0; height: 100%; background: var(--measure); }

components.name: Model Verdict
components.description: The model's label leads the report, with distinct warning and safe states.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-verdict { padding: 25px 0 22px; color: var(--ink); } .ds-verdict span { display: block; color: var(--rust); font: 500 clamp(29px, 3.1vw, 40px)/1.12 "Literata", Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -0.035em; } .ds-verdict p { max-width: 42ch; margin: 9px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font: 400 14px/1.55 "IBM Plex Sans", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-verdict.ds-is-safe span { color: var(--safe); }

narrative.overview:
Margin Proof treats phishing review as a careful reading and measurement task. Warm paper and a deep pine masthead frame an expressive editorial display face; a workhorse sans carries controls and explanations, while mono is reserved for measurements. Thin rules and open surfaces keep the page legible without turning it into a dashboard of equal-weight cards.

The page gives the email editor seven columns and the report five. The report keeps the model's label and phishing probability distinct from the narrow, rust-marked URL measurement gutter. URL traits describe observable features; they are not presented as the model's reasons for its classification.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces under a deep pine shell.
An asymmetrical editor and report, with the editor leading on narrow screens.
Mono type for measured values and a single annotated URL gutter.
Flat, open sections divided by thin rules.

rules.name: The Evidence Separation Rule
rules.body: Keep the URL measurement accent in its annotation gutter and the classification in its own verdict treatment; never make URL observations read as an explanation for the model.

rules.name: The Flat-Sheet Rule
rules.body: Keep surfaces flat at rest; use tonal contrast, rules, and placement to establish hierarchy.

dos: Do keep the 12-column asymmetry and let the email editor remain the dominant interaction.
Do keep classification and probability distinct from descriptive URL measurements.
Do use expressive editorial typography, a workhorse sans for controls, and mono only for measurements.
Do keep surfaces open and use thin rules to organize the report.
donts: Don't use Inter, Roboto, Fraunces, or a system-default display face.
Don't add purple, violet, or indigo gradients, glows, or repeated soft shadows.
Don't turn the page into a generic three-card feature grid or add placeholder emojis or decorative badges.
Don't add hover motion that does not clarify a state.
Don't present URL traits as the model's explanation or claim real-world detection performance.
